heroTitle: A pool designed around the way you live
heroText: We design, build and renovate pools that belong naturally with your home, garden and Mediterranean lifestyle.
heroNote: Complete solutions from the first idea to final start-up.
aboutTitle: More than water: a new space to enjoy
aboutText: We study the land, access, orientation and intended use before proposing a solution. The result is a well-proportioned, efficient pool that fits the property.
servicesTitle: Everything you need to enjoy your pool
servicesText: One team to plan, deliver and care for every project detail.
s1Text: Layout, dimensions, finishes, lighting and equipment adapted to the space and budget.
s2Text: Coordinated excavation, structure, waterproofing, filtration and finishing.
s3Text: New finishes, coping, lighting, steps and technical systems.
s4Text: Cleaning, water checks, filtration and regular inspections to keep your pool ready.
whyText: We explain options, materials and stages before work begins, so you can make informed decisions and follow progress with confidence.
processTitle: From the first conversation to the first swim
step1Text: We discuss the space, use, style and guide budget.
step2Text: We define shape, size, equipment, finishes and schedule.
step3Text: We coordinate the work and check every stage.
step4Text: We start the system and explain operation and care.
projectsTitle: Spaces that invite you to stay
projectsText: Every home needs a different answer. These images show some of the settings that could inspire your project.
faqIntro: Every project is different, but these are some of the most common questions.
q1: How much does a pool cost?
a1: It depends on the site, dimensions, access, structure, equipment and finishes. After studying the project, we prepare a detailed quote.
a2: Timing depends on the pool type, preliminary work, permits and site complexity. The schedule is agreed before work begins.
a3: Yes. We can renew surfaces, edges, lighting, filtration equipment, access and other elements.
a4: Yes. Service can be adapted to the season, usage and installation.
contactTitle: Turn your outdoor space into the favourite place at home
contactText: Tell us what you need, where the project is and what you have in mind. We will reply with initial guidance.

footerText: Pool design, construction, renovation and care.
